ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Ishko's Dark Landmarks
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Three new LandmarkDefs for Ishko the Unmaskable (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/sacred_sites_pass_1.md flagged him as the one god of the Nine with no curated landmark of his own): the Lightless Sink, the Shadowed Overhang, and the Cold Lava Tube.
Verified first, not assumed: no existing legal LandmarkDef in the current stack is tagged as Ishko's own. Cavern and Hollow are already referenced as generic biome-class reasoning for his nightside domain, but neither is a curated, owned landmark - these three fill that gap as new content rather than reinterpretation.
Each anchors on a real, legal TileMutatorDef (Hollow, Chasm, Cavern respectively) so no new C# is needed - the same pattern every vanilla LandmarkDef uses. Icons reuse the existing Ash'karr-styled repaints of the closest vanilla silhouette (mandrake.rut.ashkarrlandmarkart's house style) rather than shipping with no icon or a mismatched one; bespoke art is a follow-up.
Placement on the actual Ash'karr world is deliberately NOT done here - that stays the owner's hand.
